label: KB Topic
description: Subject-matter taxonomy for the KB corpus (CASE-760). Hierarchical via ontology term-relations: part_of expresses area containment (reporting part_of platform-services), is_a expresses kind-of (fresh-restore is_a restore). Navigation is by topic across all doc types; a doc may carry multiple topics. Curated vocabulary: immutable, deprecate-don't-delete.
